tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Open the Stabilise booking popup so the user can schedule a free 30-minute consultation with Dustin Rhodes (Co-Founder). Use when the user wants to book, schedule, or arrange a meeting with Stabilise.

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Submit a new enquiry to the Stabilise team on the user's behalf. Sends the same internal email and auto-confirmation as the website contact form. Only call this after the user has confirmed the details they want sent.

name.description: Full name of the person enquiring

helpWith.description: Short label for what they need help with (e.g. 'Apple IT Support', 'Infrastructure', 'Security review').

teamSize.description: Approximate number of people in the team (e.g. '12', '25-50').

painPoint.description: Free-text description of the current problem (optional).
